zenith.definition: the highest point reached by something, especially in the sky or in time
examples: At noon, the sun is near its zenith.
The project reached its zenith last year.
A zephyr cooled the hot day.
We felt a zephyr across the field.

zounds.definition: to express surprise or strong emotion
examples: Zounds, I forgot my keys again.
Zounds, that was a loud noise!

zeugma.definition: a sentence style where one word is used with multiple other parts, often in different ways
examples: The writer used a zeugma to make the sentence more efficient.
In rhetoric, zeugma can link different actions with one verb.
